thread:
jess: Quick check — I'm spinning up a PrivateLink endpoint in dev to accept partner ingestion (one-way). Need a quick security + network thumbs-up on three things: redaction rules for logs, which proxy subnets we should allow in the endpoint SG, and recommended egress constraints to the partner. TL;DR: partner IP range 198.51.100.0/24, service on 443, data is telemetry only (no PII).

kevin: Thanks — a couple quick Qs: why PrivateLink vs peering for this partner? Also do you have the exact service name/hostname from them? PrivateLink SG is host-side, so we need the consumer subnets to lock down.

jess: Using PrivateLink because partner insists on AWS endpoint and we don't want route tables touching their VPC. Service hostname is api.partner-example.net (they gave us 198.51.100.0/24). No PII, but there are client IPs in headers.

maria: Ok. Security notes: we require application-level redaction of any IP-like fields and Authorization headers before logs hit CloudWatch/ELK. Minimal checklist for the PR: 1) log sanitizer that masks IPs and token-like strings, 2) ensure no raw headers persisted, 3) add a unit/integration test for sanitizer. Example filter (pseudo):
```
# in app logging pipeline
record['headers'] = redact_headers(record.get('headers', {}), ['authorization','x-forwarded-for'])
record['client_ip'] = '<REDACTED>'
```
Also enable CloudTrail for the account and tag the endpoint resource for audit.

oliver: For network rules — recommend restricting SG ingress to our proxy ASG subnets, not the partner CIDR directly. Use the following subnets for the proxy fleet: 10.20.32.0/22 and 10.20.36.0/22. Example SG ingress rule:
```
# Terraform-style snippet
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "privlink_ingress" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.20.32.0/22", "10.20.36.0/22"]
  description = "allow proxy fleet to PrivateLink endpoint"
}
```
Egress: default-deny for the endpoint (no 0.0.0.0/0), allow only partner CIDR + AWS managed endpoints (S3, KMS) via VPC endpoints. Add route table entries so traffic to 198.51.100.0/24 goes to the interface endpoint.

maria: Also: logs must be encrypted with KMS (CMEK preferred). If any metadata could be used to re-identify users (IPs + user-agent combos), run a quick privacy review. If you need an exception window for testing, create an IAM exception ticket with duration and justification.

jess: Great — I'll open a PR that includes the sanitizer, unit tests, SG changes, and a short privacy note. Requesting a temporary test window of 48h for functional verification, then we'll enforce the SG + redaction. @maria does that sound ok?

sec-oncall-bot: Security on-call pinged: @maria assigned for 48h review window. :white_check_mark:

maria: Yep, 48h is fine. Please include the test plan and rollback steps in the PR description. I'll do the final signoff once I see the sanitizer test and the SG rule reference.

jess: Thanks all — will drop PR link in this thread once it's up. :thumbsup:
